core.name: transfer_index
core.sql:
CREATE TABLE transfer_index (
    id                  INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    signature           TEXT NOT NULL,                       -- Transaction signature
    source              TEXT NOT NULL,                       -- Source wallet address
    destination         TEXT NOT NULL,                       -- Destination wallet address
    amount_lamports     INTEGER NOT NULL,                    -- Transfer amount in lamports (avoid floats)
    amount_sol          REAL GENERATED ALWAYS AS (amount_lamports / 1e9) STORED,  -- SOL equivalent
    slot                INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,          -- Slot number (0 when unavailable from feed)
    block_time          INTEGER NOT NULL,                    -- Unix timestamp
    indexed_at          REAL NOT NULL,                       -- When indexed (time.time())
    is_valid            BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,          -- Validation flag (for cleanup)
    transfer_type       TEXT DEFAULT 'standard',             -- 'standard', 'spl_token', 'rent', etc.

    -- Composite uniqueness: one row per (tx, sender, recipient) pair
    UNIQUE (signature, source, destination),

    -- Constraints
    CHECK (amount_lamports > 0),
    CHECK (block_time > 0)
)

ops.name: operator_membership_reference_v1
ops.sql:
CREATE TABLE operator_membership_reference_v1 (
 mint TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES operator_launch_membership(mint) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 operator_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES operators(operator_id), legacy_event_id TEXT,
 reference_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(reference_kind IN ('NONE','IDENTITY_EVENT','CONFIRMED_MATCH','MEMBERSHIP_COMMIT','FUNDING_SIGNATURE')),
 identity_event_id TEXT,confirmed_match_id TEXT,membership_assigned_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
 outbox_event_id TEXT,funding_mint TEXT,funding_signature TEXT,outcome_mint TEXT,
 CHECK(typeof(membership_assigned_at)='integer'),
 CHECK(outbox_event_id IS NULL OR (length(CAST(outbox_event_id AS BLOB))=64 AND outbox_event_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')),
 CHECK(length(CAST(mint AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
 CHECK(length(CAST(operator_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
 CHECK(legacy_event_id IS NULL OR length(CAST(legacy_event_id AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
 CHECK((reference_kind='NONE' AND legacy_event_id IS NULL AND identity_event_id IS NULL AND confirmed_match_id IS NULL AND outbox_event_id IS NULL AND funding_mint IS NULL AND funding_signature IS NULL AND outcome_mint IS NULL)
 OR (reference_kind='IDENTITY_EVENT' AND legacy_event_id IS NOT NULL AND identity_event_id IS NOT NULL AND identity_event_id=legacy_event_id AND confirmed_match_id IS NULL AND outbox_event_id IS NULL AND funding_mint IS NULL AND funding_signature IS NULL AND outcome_mint IS NULL)
 OR (reference_kind='CONFIRMED_MATCH' AND legacy_event_id IS NOT NULL AND confirmed_match_id IS NOT NULL AND confirmed_match_id=legacy_event_id AND identity_event_id IS NULL AND outbox_event_id IS NULL AND funding_mint IS NULL AND funding_signature IS NULL AND outcome_mint IS NULL)
 OR (reference_kind='MEMBERSHIP_COMMIT' AND legacy_event_id IS NOT NULL AND outbox_event_id IS NOT NULL AND identity_event_id IS NULL AND confirmed_match_id IS NULL AND funding_mint IS NULL AND funding_signature IS NULL AND outcome_mint IS NOT NULL AND outcome_mint=mint)
 OR (reference_kind='FUNDING_SIGNATURE' AND legacy_event_id IS NOT NULL AND funding_mint IS NOT NULL AND funding_mint=mint AND funding_signature IS NOT NULL AND funding_signature=legacy_event_id AND identity_event_id IS NULL AND confirmed_match_id IS NULL AND outbox_event_id IS NULL AND outcome_mint IS NOT NULL AND outcome_mint=mint)),
 FOREIGN KEY(identity_event_id,operator_id) REFERENCES operator_identity_events(event_id,operator_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(confirmed_match_id,operator_id,mint) REFERENCES confirmed_operation_matches(match_id,operator_id,mint),
 FOREIGN KEY(outbox_event_id,legacy_event_id,operator_id,mint,membership_assigned_at) REFERENCES monitor_admission_outbox(event_id,membership_id,operation_id,mint,committed_at),
 FOREIGN KEY(funding_mint,funding_signature) REFERENCES wt_walkback_queue(mint,funder_sig),
 FOREIGN KEY(outcome_mint) REFERENCES wt_attribution_outcomes(mint)
)

        first_external_buy_index_in_slot INTEGER,
        our_possible_buy_slot        INTEGER,

        buys_before_first_external_buy  INTEGER,

        mc_at_detection             REAL,
        mc_at_detection_source      TEXT,
        mc_at_first_external_buy    REAL,
        mc_at_first_external_buy_source TEXT,

        peak_mc_source              TEXT,
        current_mc                  REAL,
        time_to_peak_s              INTEGER,
        retrace_from_peak_pct       REAL,
        mc_unavailable_reason       TEXT,
        curve_virtual_sol           INTEGER,

        -- outcome

        migration_signature         TEXT,
        migration_time              INTEGER,
        dumped_before_migration     INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        dump_time                   INTEGER,
        final_state                 TEXT,        -- INSTANT|STAGED|MIGRATED|DUMPED_BEFORE_MIGRATION|EXPIRED|UNKNOWN

ops.name: dev004_membership_project_insert
ops.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER dev004_membership_project_insert AFTER INSERT ON operator_launch_membership BEGIN INSERT INTO operator_membership_reference_v1(mint,operator_id,legacy_event_id,reference_kind,identity_event_id,confirmed_match_id,membership_assigned_at,outbox_event_id,funding_mint,funding_signature,outcome_mint) VALUES(NEW.mint,NEW.operator_id,NEW.event_id,CASE WHEN NEW.event_id IS NULL THEN 'NONE' WHEN COALESCE((EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM operator_identity_events e WHERE e.event_id=NEW.event_id AND e.operator_id=NEW.operator_id)),0) THEN 'IDENTITY_EVENT' WHEN COALESCE((EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM confirmed_operation_matches m WHERE m.match_id=NEW.event_id AND m.operator_id=NEW.operator_id AND m.mint=NEW.mint AND m.state='CONFIRMED_MATCH')),0) THEN 'CONFIRMED_MATCH' WHEN COALESCE(((NEW.operator_id='04265d9f-6eb2-568c-a49e-9253091a4dbb' AND NEW.source_population_id='walkback_watchtower_confirmed_projection_v1'
 AND NEW.event_id=('WATCHTOWER_CONFIRMED:'||NEW.mint||':'||CAST(NEW.assigned_at AS TEXT))
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM monitor_admission_outbox o WHERE o.membership_id=NEW.event_id
 AND o.operation_id=NEW.operator_id AND o.mint=NEW.mint AND o.committed_at=NEW.assigned_at
 AND o.semantic_version='WATCHTOWER_CONFIRMED_V1')
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wt_attribution_outcomes a WHERE a.mint=NEW.mint))),0) THEN 'MEMBERSHIP_COMMIT' WHEN COALESCE(((NEW.operator_id='04265d9f-6eb2-568c-a49e-9253091a4dbb' AND NEW.source_population_id='watchtower_behavioural_paginated_lineage_20260825'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wt_walkback_queue q WHERE q.mint=NEW.mint AND q.funder_sig=NEW.event_id)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wt_attribution_outcomes a WHERE a.mint=NEW.mint
